newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia cuts interest rates by 0.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Australia cuts interest rates by 0.5 percent.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia said Wednesday that it would cut official interest rates by 0.5 percentage points to 6.0 percent.
Rates were last cut on Nov. 6 when the official cash rate was brought down to 6.5 percent from 7.0 percent.

"This reduction essentially reflects a further improvement in the inflationary outlook," the central bank said in a statement. The bank said it now expected inflation to stay below 2.5 percent for the remainder of 1996/97.
